title: FIRST FOLLOW
style:
92 BPM — Light Tropical Acoustic / Warm Café Folk

STYLE TAGS

92 BPM, nylon-string guitar gentle plucks,
soft shaker + light cajón,
warm bass hum,
subtle marimba accents,
airy harmony vocals,
builds softly mid-song then eases back,
warm, grateful, tropical, acoustic
lyrics:
[Verse 1 – English]
I saw your name in the quiet feed
First light signal that someone believed
No crowd yet, no numbers high
Just one small star in the sky

Some people block, some disappear
Some move in shadow, some move in fear
But I move forward, open and clear
And you showed up — right here

[Pre-Chorus – Tagalog]
Salamat sa unang hakbang
(Thank you for the first step)
Sa simpleng pindot na may bigat
(In that simple click that carried weight)

[Chorus – English + Tagalog]
Island steam at nine a.m.
Ikaw ang una, my first friend
Sama-sama, kahit dalawa
(Together, even if just two)
That’s how every sunrise grew

[Verse 2 – Cebuano + English]
Maayong buntag, bag-ong sugod
(Good morning, a new beginning)
Gamayang sinugdanan, dakong kahulugan
(Small start, big meaning)

No anger in the morning light
No darkness in this vibe
We build from warmth, not fight
From coffee cups and tide

[Bridge – English, spoken soft]
I thought of you today.
Not with weight.
Not with blame.
Just gratitude.

Because every movement begins with one.

[Lift – Tagalog + English]
Simula pa lang, nandito ka
(From the beginning, you were here)
And that matters more than numbers ever will

[Final Chorus – Full harmony]
Island steam at nine a.m.
First to follow, first to send
Light and kindness, simple and true
This small beginning started with you

[Outro – Soft fade]
Salamat.
Thank you.
See you at nine.
